text: {"933":{"about":["rustc_errors"],"refers":[],"why":"It gives guidance on structuring diagnostic labels, which are created and emitted by rustc_errors."},"934":{"about":["rustc_errors","rustc_error_codes"],"refers":[],"why":"It specifies diagnostic message formatting and the use of error codes maintained by the diagnostics and error-code machinery."},"935":{"about":["rustc_error_codes"],"refers":[],"why":"It describes the long-form explanatory material associated with compiler error codes."},"936":{"about":["rustc_driver_impl","rustc_error_codes"],"refers":[],"why":"The driver implements the --explain interface while the error-code component supplies the explanations it displays."},"937":{"about":["rustc_error_codes"],"refers":[],"why":"It states the policy for assigning compiler error codes and their associated explanations."}}
